blocks.text: The central principle behind the operation of PV cells is the photovoltaic effect, which involves the generation of voltage and electric current in a material upon exposure to light. The photovoltaic effect involves the excitation of electrons from the valence band to the conduction band in semiconductors, facilitated by the energy from photons. This process is improved by the presence of a PN junction, which separates the electrons and holes, creating a voltage that drives an electric current.
